title: Low-data integral–MITM

target.description: 7-round AES-256, one standard secret master key, initial whitening and no final MixColumns; complete-key attack with 2^16 chosen plaintexts.

setting.key_relation: One fixed standard AES master key and its key schedule.
setting.plaintext_model: A complete 2^16 structure varying bytes10 and15; partition by RK0[10] xor RK0[15].

time.note: Headline encryption-equivalent time in Table1; dominant two-round work and final-key testing checked in body.

data.note: The same data/partition choice is used by all attached costs.

memory.note: Source-native byte memory from Table1/Section7, including stored row identifiers.

preprocessing.note: Setup is included in total work unless separately stated.

success.description: The source quantifies wrong-guess matching/survivor expectations, but not a fixed-budget probability of identifying the original full master key. Exhaustive completion is retained as part of the stated attack.

review.scope: PDF pp.13,15–17 Section7, all key-space partitions, expected matching/filtering and completion.

evidence.locator: PDF p.3 Table1; pp.13,15–17 Section7/Algorithm3 and constant-guessing/partitioning costs.
evidence.interpretation: Defining primary-text costs, output event and conditions checked together.

limitations: The complete named output probability is not quantified by the source.
